book_title: My Shitty Life: A Testament Victim to Survival and Advocacy
author: Tracie M. Oldham
book_description: My Shitty Life is a harrowing yet simply written, unapologetically true account of how unresolved trauma may impact a person for the rest of their life. - It recounts how, despite my unending struggles, which have seen me hit rock bottom more times than I care to remember, I have somehow overcome every challenge life has thrown at me.My life has been a turbulent one, filled with emotional, physical, and sexual abuse from childhood to maturity. In my life, everything I do is a challenge; nothing is ever simple. - Yet here I am, still standing and still fighting.I wish you the strength to reclaim your life after reading this book. Enough time has been spent pushing you aside. Turn away from the shadows and embrace the light. Your moment to shine is now.- "In the shadows of my history, I have found not a prison, but a platform from which to rise--a survivor, not a victim, reclaiming the narrative of my life." - Tracie M.
